remarks_1999: Double entries Downtown Gallery Archive. Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, 1946" [notes backing inscription]. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_post_1999: Orientation has been a subject of debate. Downtown Gallery label on verso lists dimensions as “20 x 16,” while Abiquiu label on verso lists dimensions as “16 x 20.” Both of these labels are oriented to be read horizontally. The work was displayed horizontally by Carter family and has been displayed in both orientations by the MFAH. However, a photograph in O’Keeffe’s records shows the work oriented vertically. (Source: email correspondence between Barbara Lynes and Emily Ballew Neff, May 15, 2001 in MFAH object files.)
